figure.purpose: The five summary values. Figures are numbers, not headings.

caption.purpose: Axis ticks, hints, rail counts; tabular numerals.

shadows.name: tooltip-lift
shadows.purpose: The one shared chart tooltip. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Default state transition and dialog open (--dur). Transitions are removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: panels-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Half and third panels span the full width.

breakpoints.name: shell-stacks
breakpoints.purpose: Rail becomes a horizontal strip; top bar and shell stack.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Gutter 1rem; figures two to a row; filters in two columns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a surface. Cobalt fill, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; min-height: 2rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font: inherit; font-size: 0.8125rem; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { color: var(--ink-3); background: var(--surface-2); border-color: var(--border); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions. Warm white fill with a hairline border; accent wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: var(--accent-wash); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action inside a toolbar. No border at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--accent-wash); }

components.name: Segmented Preset
components.description: Date-range presets. The selected option is a cobalt fill.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface); } .ds-seg button { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem; font: inherit; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-seg button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-seg button:hover { background: var(--accent-wash); color: var(--ink); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Filter selects and the transaction search field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-input { min-height: 2rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Left rail section link. The current section gets a surface fill and a 2px inset accent bar.
components.html: OverviewCash flow
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--ink-2); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-nav:hover { background: var(--accent-wash); color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The only container for page content. Bordered, never nested, flat at rest.
components.html:
Top merchants

Spend in the selected range
components.css: .ds-panel { min-width: 0; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.9rem 1rem 1rem; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-panel-head h2 { font-size: 1.1875rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 0; } .ds-panel-desc { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-2); margin: 0.15rem 0 0; }

components.name: Needs Review Badge
components.description: Marks a transaction the owner should check. Text prefix carries the meaning; colour only reinforces it.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 0.05rem 0.4rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--serious); color: var(--ink-2); white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
The interface works like an analyst's desk, and its advice is plain. The owner is reading their own statements, so the screen leads with exact figures and their sources: five plain numbers above the monthly cash-flow chart, then a drill from category to sub-category to shop without leaving the page.

The system is quiet on purpose. A paper-white ground, graphite text, 1px hairlines, and one cobalt accent carry the structure. Colour in the charts is reserved for categories and labelled directly. Nothing decorative competes with a figure, and nothing shows a figure without its source.

The advice answer is the only element that leaves the page. It opens in a native dialog, separated from the data it discusses.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral ground, graphite text, and one cobalt accent.
Flat surfaces, structured by hairlines rather than shadows.
Five plain figures above a full-width chart. No hero numbers and no gradient tiles.
Eight categorical chart colours, always paired with direct labels or a legend.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks only what is selected, focused, or the primary action. Series 1 shares the hue by design, and no other element uses it.

rules.name: The Status Is Never Identity Rule
rules.body: Status colours never name a series or category. Each is paired with a text label or an icon.

rules.name: The Three Step Rule
rules.body: Each heading step is at least 1.25 times the step below it, so the page title, panel title, and body read as three distinct levels.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px borders. Panels never nest, and they never gain a shadow at rest.

rules.name: The Table Twin Rule
rules.body: No chart value may be reachable only through a hover. Each chart ships with its table.

dos: Do reserve Clear Cobalt (#2873cc) for the primary action, the selected item, focus, and series 1.
Do pair every colour-coded status or series with a text label, a legend entry, or an icon.
Do give each chart a table twin in the DOM.
Do label estimates as estimates in the text, for example the emergency fund and loan balances until the owner enters them.
Do use the 1px hairline border for panel and section structure.
donts: Don't use gradients, glows, or drop shadows on panels, figures, or charts at rest.
Don't nest panels, or use cards as the page's structure.
Don't use emoji or Unicode symbols as icons.
Don't load web fonts. The stack is system-ui.
Don't cycle chart colours beyond eight categories, or use a ninth generated hue.
Don't hard-code colour values outside web/css/tokens.css. Reference the tokens by role.
